title: 第3章 乌勒斥候
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林珝这辈子都没跑得这么快过。

不对、上辈子也没有。

高速的奔跑让他呼吸急促，肺里好似灌满了玻璃渣，每次呼吸都火辣辣的疼。

可他不敢停下，他专挑难走的地方跑，故意制造了一些凌乱的脚步，想利用环境把追兵甩开。

前世当过兵，学过一些野外的追踪和反追踪技能，刚好用得上。

跑了一刻钟后，他发现了一片松树林，急忙躲到一块石头后面。

但没多久，身后就有急促的脚步声跟上来。

两个喽啰对这里的环境太熟悉了，光靠躲，根本甩不开对方。

林珝蹲在石缝里，手心全是汗。

前世倒是学过一些搏击技巧，但拳台的首要规则是禁止玩命。

带伤的情况下，面对两个拿刀的悍匪，胜算实在不高。

“该死的……”林珝暗自咒骂，强迫自己冷静下来，开始观察地形，迅速在脑海制定计划。

乱石坡的正前方有一片松树林，前面是一条小溪，可以通往山脚下的平原。

林珝加快脚步，来到溪水附近，一头扎进小溪，仰面朝上，勉强露出两个鼻孔呼吸。

刚躲好不久，后面脚步声就近了。

林珝在水下睁开眼，看见两个人正在分散寻找自己留下的脚印。

“那边，好像往水里去了。”

“追！”

距离被不断拉近，沙沙的脚步摩擦声像一把钝刀，在不断切割林珝的神经。

“只能拼一把了！”

林珝蛰伏在水里，盯着受伤小喽啰的后脑勺，盘算该从哪个角度偷袭。

忽然，他听到松木林外传来的一声马嘶，呼吸猛地一滞。

居然是战马的声音！

林珝一脸惊愕，躲在一堆水草后面，眯着眼睛往那边看去。

同时那两个追兵的脚步声也停了下来。

他们显然也听到了战马的嘶鸣，齐刷刷地偏过头，目光从地上的脚印移向树林外缘。

同一时间，一道尖锐的破风声穿过树林。

林珝还没反应过来那是什么，就看到小喽啰的左腿猛地往后一挫。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Jue has never run so fast in his life.

No, not even in my previous life.

The high-speed running made him breathe quickly, and his lungs seemed to be filled with glass slag. Every time he took a breath, it was burning and painful.

But he didn't dare to stop. He ran in difficult places and deliberately made some messy steps, hoping to use the environment to throw away the pursuers.

I had been a soldier in my previous life and had learned some tracking and anti-tracking skills in the wild, which came in handy.

After running for a quarter of an hour, he found a pine forest and hurriedly hid behind a stone.

But not long after, there were rapid footsteps following behind.

The two minions were so familiar with the environment here that they couldn't get rid of each other just by hiding.

Lin Jue squatted in the crevice of the stone, her palms all sweaty.

I had learned some fighting skills in my previous life, but the first rule of the boxing ring was that it was forbidden to risk one's life.

Even though he was injured, facing two gangsters with knives, his chances of winning were really low.

"Damn..." Lin Jue cursed secretly, forced herself to calm down, began to observe the terrain, and quickly made a plan in her mind.

There is a pine forest directly in front of the rocky slope, and in front is a small stream that leads to the plain at the foot of the mountain.

Lin Jue quickened her pace and came to the stream. She plunged into the stream and lay face up, barely exposing her two nostrils for breathing.

Not long after hiding, footsteps approached from behind.

Lin Jue opened her eyes underwater and saw two people scattered looking for the footprints she left.

"Over there, it seems to be going into the water."

"Chase!"

The distance was getting closer and closer, and the rustling sound of footsteps was like a dull knife, constantly cutting Lin Sui's nerves.

"We just have to give it a try!"

Lin Jue lay dormant in the water, staring at the back of the injured boy's head, trying to figure out which angle to attack from.

Suddenly, he heard a horse neighing from outside the pine forest, and his breath suddenly stopped.

It was actually the sound of a war horse!

With a look of astonishment on his face, Lin Jue hid behind a pile of water plants and looked over there with squinted eyes.

At the same time, the footsteps of the two pursuers also stopped.

Apparently they also heard the neighing of the war horses. They all turned their heads and looked from the footprints on the ground to the outer edge of the woods.

At the same time, a sharp sound of breaking wind passed through the woods.

Before Lin Jue realized what it was, he saw the little guy's left leg snap back.
